messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: 2318004321 — ALERT: authz-service token verification errors > 8% (okta-introspect) across eu-west-1. Paging oncall.

jordan (sre-oncall): Got the page, looking now. Seeing a big spike in 502s from okta-introspect endpoints in the edge. Console and login flows showing failures for ~10% of sessions.

ryan (eng-runtime): I can pull traces. Any correlation with a deploy? I see no deployment in the last 30m.

megan (platform): No platform deploys. Metrics show sudden latency + error rate from third-party okta API. Also some 401s on our token-verifier lambda hitting introspect.

sasha (support): Support is starting to get tickets: customers in EU complaining they can’t open the admin console — appears as a login loop or 500. Escalating with initial customer-impact note.

jordan (sre-oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Route traffic to fallback verifier (local jwks cache) for non-sensitive routes. 2) Increase client-side retry with exponential backoff for introspect calls. 3) Enable circuit breaker for failing okta calls to avoid cascading latencies. Can eng-runtime push the fallback? @ryan

ryan (eng-runtime): I can flip the runtime flag to prefer local JWKS for token signature verification (not introspect) — that avoids the network call if tokens are signed. For introspect-based session checks, we can enable a cached TTL extension to 60s. Will prepare a canary config change.

kai (security): Be careful — switching to signature-only verification will bypass active session revocation checks. We should scope it to console login read-only paths and avoid admin-critical flows. I approve limited scope TTL extension for 60s.

ryan (eng-runtime): Understood. Pushing a canary to eu-west-1 now: config snippet:
```
AUTHZ_INTROSPECT_MODE: "hybrid"
INTROSPECT_CACHE_TTL: 60
INTROSPECT_SIGNATURE_FALLBACK: true
SCOPE_OVERRIDE: ["console-login","ui-read"]
```

devops-bot: deploy started by ryan — rollout id: fk-2318-01 — canary eu-west-1 -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%

jordan (sre-oncall): Monitoring errors. If 10% canary looks good for 3m, expand. Also enabling queueing on frontends to smooth bursts.

(3m later)

devops-bot: canary passed: 10% -> 50%

ryan (eng-runtime): Expanding to 100% in eu-west-1. Logs show introspect error rate falling to ~1.2% and console 5xxs dropping.

sasha (support): Messaging support: "We’re seeing partial login failures in EU due to Okta API issues. We’ve applied a limited fallback to reduce impact; some customers may need to refresh their session. We’ll update in 15m." Drafted and sent.

oncall-manager: Good mitigation. Please create an incident summary for postmortem. Triage severity: Sev2 (partial customer impact, mitigation deployed, external dependency).

megan (platform): Noting follow-ups: - Request Okta status link and incident number. - Add metric alarm for introspect 5xx rate at 1% threshold. - Run a sweep to find routes that still require introspect and consider long-term cached verifier.

kai (security): Add an audit note about the temporary signature-only scope and the risk acceptance for 60s TTL. We'll require a rollback if Okta confirms revocations were occurring.

jordan (sre-oncall): Okta status: https://status.okta.com/incidents/okta-xyz (posted by @megan). They report degraded introspect API in europe region.

ryan (eng-runtime): Pushing follow-up: increased local jwks refresh to 5m and adding an opt-in flag for customers with stricter security to force introspect-only. Config applied.

devops-bot: rollout complete.

(15m later)

jordan (sre-oncall): Final check: error rate normalized to baseline, console accessibility restored for impacted customers. Closing paging for now. Will keep monitoring for 1h.

sasha (support): Noted — notifying affected customers with final update and offering session reset instructions.

megan (platform): Action items created: #1 create durable fallback path for introspect outages; #2 add alert; #3 run DR playbook with Okta (contact + escalation). Assigning next steps to platform and security.

oncall-manager: Thanks team. Please add this to incidents board and schedule a 1-hour postmortem tomorrow to capture timeline, mitigation, and permanent fixes.

jordan (sre-oncall): Adding initial timeline to the incident doc and will handoff to morning oncall in 30m. Handoff: if errors reappear, escalate to oncall-manager and notify customers via status page.

incidents-bot: Incident ack closed by jordan (sre-oncall).
